text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, and controlling threats to an organization. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding possible problems that could harm a project or business. Once risks are identified, teams develop mitigation strategies to reduce their impact or likelihood. For example, they might create backup systems or train staff. It is also important to prepare contingency plans, which are actions to take if a risk actually happens. Finally, monitoring means regularly checking risks and reviewing whether the strategies are working. Good risk management helps organizations avoid surprises and respond quickly when problems appear.
